guidelines: Source-driven behavior specification; not an aircraft-certified FMC or executable VNAV guidance
Never alter approved CDU panel artwork, approved 70 key hitboxes or BoeingCDULarge/BoeingCDUSmall font binaries
Never infer missing thresholds or numerical prediction models from these diagrams
Alternative/duplicate FCOM paragraphs must remain separate until equipment/software effectivity is established
Publish only independent paraphrase and short technical labels; do not reproduce original screenshots in public repository

rules.notes: Source does not specify independent EXEC/ERASE requirements. Do not fabricate them.
Data contract only, not authorization to drive A/T.
Diagram is not enough to infer full transition law.

This is an exceptional fallback, not a flyable geometric path.

240 KTS is tied to the stated airport speed restriction altitude; do not assume universal 10,000 ft.
